top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two out of five children records did not contain the required emergency medical authorization.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that a child was left unattended, the caregiver was not at a physical proximity that allowed visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children (26 TAC §746.1201(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Evidence obtained during the investigation shows that a staff member was not relating to children with courtesy or respect as they called children names that were not kind.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child in care did not have an immunization record available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Sheltering drill for Severe Weather- 4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §747.5005(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not completed a sheltering drill for severe weather.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Dates (26 TAC §747.2103(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The activity plan did not have dates for what the plan covers.

top_violation_types.title: Rotated Menus Dated (26 TAC §747.3113(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection the menus were posted without a date and month written.
